components.name: Fractionless count-defect, exponent-coordinate, valuation-repair, and typed future-language compiler layer
components.project_addition: Demotes finite rational normalization to external views of primitive integer count rays; packages ratio comparison, Bell separation, threshold tests and macro monotonicity as signed integer defects; linearizes P005 multiplicative scales into finite prime-exponent words with separate rank omega and total depth Omega; and develops a typed, operation-conditioned representation compiler. One p-power axis plus arbitrary finite translations compiles to an exact p-adic center/exit trie; subgroup depth t has K-t+p^t classes and discrete-convex repair excess p^t-t-1. Product/full-vector futures factor through marginal compilers even for correlated joint actions, while coupled observables show that true joint state appears only when future semantics itself couples axes. Coupled futures with proved modular relation factorization compile through full-row-rank relation matrices; additive-congruence future kernels compile to quotient modules whose invariant prime-exponent profiles are recovered from exact torsion counts. If modular congruence fails, the compiler next tests whether the finite future partition is the restriction of a rational-linear quotient in an integer lift: intra-class difference span plus fraction-free determinant minors give an exact relation token whenever no inter-class difference lies in that span. The codimension-one token recovers primitive integer sum/difference relations, and the rank-one determinant specialization is exactly the existing A3 weighted relation field up to sign, with A3 closure identified as the corresponding exterior integrability identity. A bare future kernel is not a complete semantic specification: the same parity kernel on Z/4 supports distinct descended operations (XOR from addition, AND from multiplication). Therefore typed operations/relations/witness requirements must remain compiler input and receive explicit descent certificates; failure of arithmetic/linear structured gates falls back to the generic P023 typed functional quotient for deterministic futures, while A3/A4 relation/witness state is required only when the declared future semantics itself needs those richer structures. P023/P024/A3/A4 ownership and all underlying p-adic, CRT, group-congruence, finite-abelian, Smith-normal-form, determinant and exterior-algebra mathematics remain prior/upstream. Historical novelty of the compiler architecture and exact cross-owner reduction package remains unverified.
